findings: Static routes already bypass the VM; fixed responses are captured at serve time.
Server and client samples are dominated by socket syscalls and event-loop activity, so the multiworker scaling limit is in the network path rather than guest dispatch.
Wait samples in kevent are wall time, not a measure of CPU consumption. The exact kernel/scheduler cause has not been isolated.
Header batching wins at one worker; the four-worker change is within noise. Keep only the batched static-header implementation.
Eight client threads worsened throughput and tail latency in the diagnostic; those numbers are not mixed into the controlled comparison.
